verdict.rationale: Jan documents a static API Reference for its local OpenAI-compatible server (GET /v1/models, POST /v1/chat/completions, POST /v1/messages). Each endpoint has curl examples and sample responses that a user can run against localhost:1337. The reference itself is not interactive: the docs mention no try-it console or sandbox, and probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. Missing for 10: an interactive try-it console or sandbox in the docs, a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec, and independent corroboration of the reference's usability.
